note: Regional park on the west edge of Bengough, within walking distance of the town's shops; treed main campground, an outdoor pool with hot tub, a nine-hole sand-green golf course and a short hiking trail. 17 newer sites are sold as seasonal. Castle Butte is about 20 km south. --Claude
